请在对应目标里重新录入密钥，否则工具会拒绝使用它。: Re-enter the key for those targets or tools will refuse to use them.
先选一个类型登记连接与只读范围，三个客户端随后就能按名称调用它。: Choose a type, register the connection and read-only scope, then clients can call it by name.
调整搜索词或类型筛选后再试。: Adjust the search or type filter and try again.
不同系统的连接方式、授权范围和只读规则不同，先选类型再填连接。: Each system has different connection, scope, and read-only rules. Choose a type first.
小写字母、数字与连字符，创建后不可修改；模型调用时传这个名字。: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Cannot be changed later; clients pass this name.
停用后模型无法使用该目标，配置会保留。: When disabled, clients cannot use this target; configuration is kept.
只读闸门只会访问这里列出的范围；留空时按该类型的默认语义处理。: Read-only guards only access the listed scope; empty values use the type default.
密钥只保存密文，页面不会回显；留空表示沿用原值。: Secrets are stored encrypted and never rendered; leave blank to keep the current value.
这些上限同样作用在测试连接与后续工具调用上。: These limits also apply to connection tests and later tool calls.
服务对八个组件绝对只读；账号即使有写权限也不会被使用。: All eight components are strictly read-only; write-capable accounts are not used for writes.
只允许小写字母、数字与连字符，以字母或数字开头结尾，最长 64 个字符。同一个环: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; start and end with a letter or digit; max 64 characters. Names must be unique inside one environment, and can be reused in another.
新建时必填项不能为空；编辑时留空沿用、勾选清除或填新值替换，三者互斥。: On create, required secrets cannot be empty. On edit, leave blank to keep, check clear, or enter a new value.
保存后会加密落盘，审计与日志不记录密钥。: Saved secrets are encrypted at rest; audit and logs never contain them.
完整字段说明与只读规则见仓库: See the repository for full field and read-only rules:
删除会一并移除该目标的密钥与配置；模型将立即无法调用它，且无法恢复。: Deleting removes this target's secrets and configuration immediately and cannot be undone.
这会把该项恢复为代码默认值，并写入审计。: This restores this setting to its default and writes an audit entry.
这会把所有系统配置恢复为代码默认值，并写入审计。: This restores all settings to their defaults and writes an audit entry.
目标、密钥、安全边界不会受影响；只恢复本页的运行策略。: Targets, secrets, and security boundaries are unaffected; only runtime settings are reset.
保存本组会写入审计；切换分组前请先保存。: Saving this section writes an audit entry; save before switching sections.
这些规则是硬边界，不通过系统配置放宽。: These are hard boundaries and are not relaxed by settings.
只读白名单、危险命令、目标范围、密钥与 TLS 校验不受系统配置影响。: Read-only allowlists, dangerous commands, target scope, secrets, and TLS verification are not affected by settings.
本页只调整默认值和运行节奏，不改变“能查什么、能连哪里”。: This page only adjusts defaults and cadence; it does not change what can be queried or connected.
行数、字节、超时和并发只影响资源消耗，不绕过目标授权范围。: Row, byte, timeout, and concurrency limits only affect resource use and do not bypass target scope.
危险与高开销规则、目标级 CA/mTLS、密钥加密始终生效。: Dangerous/high-cost rules, target-level CA/mTLS, and secret encryption always apply.
由环境变量/启动参数控制，修改需要重启；这里只读展示。: Controlled by environment/startup parameters; changes need a restart. Read-only here.
这些值由环境变量/启动参数控制，修改后需要重启；密钥内容不展示。: Controlled by environment/startup parameters; changes need a restart. Secret values are not shown.
登记线上系统并授权只读范围，模型按名称调用排查工具。: Register online systems and grant read-only scope; clients call them by name.
按分组切换配置；每次保存只影响当前分组，生效时机写在字段旁。: Switch sections to edit settings; saving affects only the current section. Effects are shown beside fields.
只允许单条 SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / EXPLAIN: Only a single SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / EXPLAIN is allowed; the session is forced read-only.
选择认证方式；无认证实例选 none。find 必须带过滤条件，聚合只允许读阶段: Choose an auth mode; use none for unauthenticated instances. find requires a filter; aggregations are read-only and $group/$lookup need a preceding $match.
只发 GET / HEAD 与 _search / _count 的 POST；: GET/HEAD only, plus POST to _search/_count; scripts and deep pagination are rejected.
命令白名单；支持 ACL 用户名、TLS CA 与客户端证书；无界范围与全键命令: Command allowlist; supports ACL usernames, TLS CA, and client certificates. Unbounded ranges and all-key commands are rejected.
只发 GET；Token 权限再大也不会写。: GET only; a write-capable token is still never used for writes.
只走 Management API 的 GET，不取消息。: Management API GET only; messages are not consumed.
只做描述类接口与保留范围内的有限拉取，不加入消费组；SASL 字段必须完整。: Describe APIs and bounded fetches within retention; no consumer group; SASL fields must be complete.
搜索必须带时间窗，单次不超过 24 小时。: Search requires a time window of at most 24 hours.
允许的库（一行一个，空=只允许默认库）: Allowed databases (one per line; empty = default only)
CA 证书 PEM（可选，私有 CA 时填写）: CA certificate PEM (optional; for private CAs)
连接 URI（auth_mode=uri 时必填，含凭证）: Connection URI (required for auth_mode=uri; contains credentials)
默认 2（RESP2），兼容 Redis < 6.0 与 Codis/Twemp: Default 2 (RESP2), compatible with Redis < 6.0 and proxies such as Codis/Twemproxy; set to 3 only when the server is Redis ≥ 6.0 and RESP3 is actually needed.
格式：日志集ID/日志主题ID（均为控制台 UUID，不是主题名称）。: Format: logsetId/topicId (console UUIDs, not topic names).
每行须为「日志集ID/日志主题ID」UUID（控制台复制），不能使用主题名称。: Each line must be logsetId/topicId UUIDs from the console, not topic names.
粘贴 PEM 证书；配置后必须启用 SSL。: Paste the PEM certificate; SSL must be enabled when set.
默认关闭；开启后 PROCESSLIST 可看到实例内其他库/用户的会话与 SQ: Disabled by default; when enabled, PROCESSLIST exposes sessions and SQL from other databases/users.
mTLS 客户端证书，与私钥必须同时提供；不加密的私钥。: mTLS client certificate; must be provided with the private key. The key must be unencrypted.
mTLS 客户端私钥，与证书必须同时提供；当前不支持带口令私钥。: mTLS client private key; must be provided with the certificate. Encrypted keys are not supported.
none = no auth; password = username/password; uri = full connection string (SRV/X.509/TLS and other advanced options).
配置后必须启用 TLS。: TLS must be enabled when set.
完整 mongodb:// 或 mongodb+srv:// URI；凭证里未转: Full mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// URI; unescaped @, : and % in credentials are URL-encoded automatically; credentials are encrypted.
粘贴 PEM 证书；配置后必须保持 TLS 校验开启。: Paste the PEM certificate; TLS verification must stay enabled when set.
新建目标表单的默认 timeout_s；既有目标仍使用各自配置。: Default timeout_s for new targets; existing targets keep their own value.
新建目标表单的默认 max_rows；既有目标仍使用各自配置。: Default max_rows for new targets; existing targets keep their own value.
新建目标表单的默认 max_bytes；既有目标仍使用各自配置。: Default max_bytes for new targets; existing targets keep their own value.
同一个目标同时进行的工具调用上限，超出会排队。: Max concurrent tool calls per target; excess calls queue.
超过该天数的审计记录会被定时清理；清理只记日志。: Audit entries older than this are cleaned periodically; cleanup only logs.
进程内缓存的连接器客户端数量；修改后在下一次取客户端时按新上限淘汰。: Max cached connector clients; the new limit applies on the next client lookup.
每轮清理后按该间隔休眠；修改后下一轮开始使用新值。: Sleep this interval after each cleanup; the new value applies next cycle.
只影响新建目标表单；既有目标保留各自已保存的 timeout / 行数 / 字节: Affects new target forms only; existing targets keep their saved timeout/rows/bytes.
并发上限立即生效；审计留存与清理间隔在下一轮清理周期生效。: Concurrency applies immediately; audit retention and cleanup interval apply next cycle.
影响进程内缓存与资源占用；修改后下一次工具调用生效，不需要重启。: Affects in-process cache and resource use; applies on the next tool call without restart.
失败原因已记录在目标行，可展开查看。: The error is recorded on the target row and can be expanded.
目标不存在或已被删除: Target not found or already deleted
配置连接、密钥与只读范围。: Configure the connection, secrets, and read-only scope.
配置 CA 证书时必须启用 TLS: TLS must be enabled when a CA certificate is configured
配置 CA 证书时 security_protocol 必须是 SSL 或 SA: security_protocol must be SSL or SASL_SSL when a CA certificate is configured
配置 CA 证书时必须启用 SSL: SSL must be enabled when a CA certificate is configured
配置 CA 证书时必须保持 TLS 校验开启: TLS verification must stay enabled when a CA certificate is configured
Elasticsearch 需要「用户名 + 密码」或 API Key，二选一: Elasticsearch requires either username + password or an API key
客户端证书与私钥必须同时提供或同时清除: Client certificate and private key must be provided or cleared together
配置 ACL 用户名时必须填写密码: A password is required when an ACL username is configured
auth_mode=none 时不能填写 URI、用户或密码: auth_mode=none does not allow URI, user, or password
无认证模式需要填写主机: Host is required in no-auth mode
CA 证书不是合法 PEM: CA certificate is not valid PEM
SASL 机制必须是 PLAIN / SCRAM-SHA-256 / SCRAM: SASL mechanism must be PLAIN / SCRAM-SHA-256 / SCRAM-SHA-512
SASL 协议需要填写 SASL 用户: SASL user is required for SASL protocols
SASL 协议需要填写 SASL 密码: SASL password is required for SASL protocols
非 SASL 协议不应填写 SASL 机制: SASL mechanism is not allowed for non-SASL protocols
非 SASL 协议不应填写 SASL 用户或密码: SASL user/password are not allowed for non-SASL protocols
默认时间窗不能大于最大时间窗: Default window cannot exceed max window
auth_mode=password 时不能填写连接 URI: auth_mode=password does not allow a connection URI
密码模式需要填写主机: Host is required in password mode
密码模式需要填写用户: User is required in password mode
密码模式需要填写密码: Password is required in password mode
URI 模式需要填写连接 URI: A connection URI is required in URI mode
auth_mode=uri 时 host、用户、密码必须留空: auth_mode=uri requires host, user, and password to be empty
仅 SQLite 且存在 pending migration 时生效；新迁移前保: Only applies to SQLite when a pending migration exists; keep the latest N backups before a new migration.
影响进程内缓存与 SQLite 备份保留；修改后下一次工具调用或下一次启动迁移生: Affects in-process cache and SQLite backup retention; applies on the next tool call or next startup migration.
登录以管理排查目标与系统配置。: Sign in to manage targets and settings.
系统默认只有一个管理员账号 admin。密码至少 8 位，保存后请妥善保管。: The system has one administrator account, admin. Use at least 8 characters and keep the password safe.
至少 8 位。密码只保存 scrypt 哈希。: At least 8 characters. Only the scrypt hash is stored.
配置库保存管理员、排查目标、系统配置与审计。默认 SQLite；选择 MySQL: The config store keeps administrators, targets, settings, and audit data. SQLite is the default; MySQL/PostgreSQL require connection details and a successful test.
默认 data/dr-panda.sqlite；已有旧库时请保留此路径以保留数据: Defaults to data/dr-panda.sqlite. Keep this path to preserve an existing database.
该账号需要能创建/迁移配置库表；测试只验证连通性，完成时会执行真实迁移。: The account needs permission to create/migrate tables. The test checks connectivity; the real migration runs on finish.
请立即保存下面的 MCP Token；关闭页面后将不再显示。: Save the MCP token now; it will not be shown again.
MCP Token 只显示一次: MCP token is shown only once
客户端通过 Authorization: Bearer <token> 访问 /: Clients use Authorization: Bearer <token> to access /mcp.
密码至少需要 8 位: Password must be at least 8 characters
密码不能超过 256 位: Password must be at most 256 characters
该配置库已有管理员，请使用已有安装登录: This config store already has an administrator; use the existing installation login
安装写入失败，请检查配置库权限: Installation write failed; check config store permissions
Web 登录会话有效期；修改后立即生效。: Web login session lifetime; changes take effect immediately.
Web 登录会话的最长有效期；修改后现有会话也按新值校验。: Maximum lifetime of a web login session; existing sessions are checked against the new value.
登录尝试次数过多，请稍后再试: Too many login attempts; try again later
管理账号密码和 MCP 客户端凭证。: Manage your password and MCP client credentials.
新 Token 只显示一次，请立即保存: New token is shown only once; save it now
旧 Token 已立即失效，请更新 Cursor / Codex / DeepS: The old token is invalid immediately. Update Cursor / Codex / DeepSeek Harness configuration.
完整 Token 不会再次显示。如果丢失，请重新生成；重新生成后旧 Token: The full token is never shown again. If lost, regenerate it; the old token is invalidated immediately.
至少 8 位。修改成功后需要重新登录。: At least 8 characters. You will need to sign in again after changing it.
新密码不能与当前密码相同: New password must differ from the current password
请立即保存下面的 MCP Token；之后可在“我的”页面重新生成。: Save the MCP token now; you can regenerate it later from My account.
客户端通过 Authorization: Bearer <token> 访问 /: Clients use Authorization: Bearer <token> for /mcp; if lost, sign in and regenerate it from My account.
密码已修改，请重新登录: Password changed; please sign in again
每个 Token 独立有效，删除后立即失效。: Each token is independent; deleting one invalidates it immediately.
生成一个 Token 给 Cursor、Codex 或 DeepSeek Har: Generate a token for Cursor, Codex, or DeepSeek Harness.
删除后该 Token 立即失效，且无法恢复；其他 Token 不受影响。: This token becomes invalid immediately and cannot be recovered; other tokens are unaffected.
这会立即断开使用该 Token 的客户端: This immediately disconnects clients using this token
如果这是最后一个 Token，MCP 将暂时不可用，直到重新生成。: If this is the last token, MCP will be unavailable until a new one is generated.
完整 Token 只显示一次，关闭页面后无法再次查看。: The full token is shown only once and cannot be viewed again after closing the page.
请把它配置到对应客户端；丢失后只能删除并重新生成。: Configure it in the matching client. If lost, delete it and create another.
管理账号密码和 MCP 客户端访问凭证。: Manage your password and MCP client credentials.
名称可选，用于区分 Cursor、Codex 等客户端。: Name is optional; use it to distinguish Cursor, Codex, and other clients.
将在当前服务所在项目安装 {name} 客户端，不会卸载已经装好的其他客户端。: This installs the {name} client into the project running this service. Clients that are already installed stay installed.
已有客户端正在安装，请稍后再试: Another client install is already running. Try again shortly.
当前失败不是缺少客户端，无需安装: This failure is not a missing client, so there is nothing to install.
无 JS 时可点击 Token 全选，然后按 ⌘C / Ctrl+C 复制。: Without JS, click the token to select it, then press Ctrl/Cmd+C.
Token 名称已存在，请换一个: Token name already exists; choose another
新建时必填；保存后只存密文，不回显。: Required for a new target; stored encrypted and never displayed.
先填写连接信息；保存前建议先测试连接。: Fill in the connection details; test before saving.
新建时必填项不能为空；编辑时留空沿用、勾选清除或填新值替换，三者互斥。保存后加密: Required for a new target. When editing, leave blank to keep, check clear, or enter a new value. Stored encrypted and never displayed.
连接可用，可以保存目标。: Connection works; you can save the target.
连接测试通过，可以保存。: Connection test passed. You can save now.
已通过连接测试，可以保存。: Connection test passed; you can save.
配置已修改，请重新测试连接。: Configuration changed; test the connection again.
连接未修改，可以直接保存。: Connection is unchanged. You can save.
主机、账号、密钥、TLS 或超时变化后，需要重新测试才能保存。: Test again before saving if the host, account, secret, TLS, or timeout changes.
这些上限作用于之后的工具调用。: These limits apply to later tool calls.
有未保存的修改，离开后会丢失。确定离开？: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
仅在 SQLite 配置库上生效，当前配置库不会使用这项。: This only applies to a SQLite config database. The current database does not use it.
同一个目标同时进行的工具调用上限，超出会排队。已经在跑的调用不会被取消。: Max concurrent tool calls per target. Extra calls wait. Calls already running are not cancelled.
Web 登录会话的最长有效期，最短 30 分钟。缩短后，已超过新时长的会话在下一: Maximum web login session length. Minimum 30 minutes. After you shorten it, sessions older than the new length expire on the next request. Active sessions renew to the current length.
连接器缓存在下一次取客户端时生效。SQLite 备份份数只在下次启动迁移前生效。: The connector cache applies the next time a client is fetched. SQLite backup count applies only before the next startup migration.
并发上限在下一次取槽生效；已经在跑的调用不会被取消。审计留存与清理间隔在下一轮清: The concurrency limit applies the next time a slot is taken. Calls already running are not cancelled. Audit retention and cleanup interval apply on the next cleanup cycle.
Web 登录会话有效期。缩短后，已超过新时长的会话在下一次请求失效；使用中的会话: Web login session length. After you shorten it, sessions older than the new length expire on the next request. Active sessions renew to the current length.
这会把所有系统配置恢复为代码默认值，并写入审计。目标、密钥和安全边界不受影响。: This restores every system setting to its code default and writes an audit record. Targets, secrets, and the read-only boundary are unchanged.
这会把该项恢复为代码默认值，并写入审计。之后仍可再改。: This restores this setting to its code default and writes an audit record. You can change it again later.
保存前会先检查连接；测试通过后即可保存。: The connection is checked before saving. Save becomes available after a successful test.
网络异常，请检查连接后重试。: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
请求超时，请稍后重试。: Request timed out. Please try again.
页面已过期，请刷新后重试。: This page has expired. Refresh and try again.
操作失败，请稍后重试。: Something went wrong. Please try again.
登录状态已失效，请重新登录: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
先选定环境，再登记这个环境里的目标。模型调用时要带上环境的调用标识。: Choose an environment, then register its targets. Tool calls use the environment call key.
例如乐畅生产、测试: For example, Lechang production or Test
已有目标都在这里。展示名可以改，但模型调用时仍要传 default。要按乐畅生产: Existing targets are here. You can change the display name, but tool calls still use default. To separate Lechang production and Test, create those environments and register targets there.
模型不能查询其中的目标。配置仍保留，可以随时重新启用。: Tools cannot query its targets. The configuration stays, and you can enable it again.
先新建环境，例如乐畅生产或测试，再在里面登记目标。: Create an environment, such as Lechang production or Test, then register targets in it.
先选一个类型登记连接与只读范围。同一个环境里可以有多台相同类型的目标，用不同名称: Choose a type and register the connection and read-only scope. One environment can contain several targets of the same type, distinguished by name.
目标会登记到这个环境，保存后不能更换。不同环境可以有同名目标。: The target is saved in this environment and cannot be moved later. Different environments can reuse the same target name.
创建后不能更换环境。: The environment cannot be changed after creation.
环境创建后不可修改: The environment cannot be changed after creation.
乐畅生产、畅聊生产和测试各是一个环境。模型先选环境，再查这个环境里的目标。: Lechang production, Changliao production, and Test are separate environments. The model picks an environment, then queries only its targets.
展示名是你和模型对话时用的名字，例如乐畅生产。调用标识是模型传入的 enviro: The display name is what you and the model say, such as Lechang production. The call key is the environment value the model passes, such as lechang-prod. The call key cannot be changed later.
新建一个环境后，再回到目标里登记 MySQL、日志和其他系统。: After you create an environment, go back to Targets and register MySQL, logs, and the other systems.
有目标时不能删除: Cannot delete while it has targets
删除 {title}（{key}）。这个环境里没有目标。: Delete {title} ({key}). This environment has no targets.
展示名给人看，调用标识给模型用。同一个环境里可以登记多台相同类型的目标。: The display name is for people. The call key is for the model. One environment can hold several targets of the same type.
对话里怎么称呼这个环境。以后可以修改。: The name you use in conversation. You can change it later.
小写字母、数字与连字符。模型调用工具时传这个值，创建后不能修改。: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. The model passes this value. It cannot be changed later.
停用后模型不能查询这个环境，目标配置仍保留。: After you disable it, tools cannot query this environment. Target configuration stays.
展示名最长 64 个字符: Display name must be at most 64 characters

先新建环境，再在里面登记目标。: Create an environment, then register targets in it.
展示名可以改，调用标识创建后不能改。: You can change the display name. The call key cannot be changed later.
调用标识是 default，不能改。要分开多套环境，请新建一个。: The call key is default and cannot be changed. To keep environments separate, create a new one.
创建后不能修改，排查时要传这个值。: It cannot be changed later. Pass this value when investigating.
小写字母、数字和连字符。创建后不能修改，排查时要传这个值。: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It cannot be changed later. Pass this value when investigating.
停用后不能查询这个环境，目标配置仍保留。: After you disable it, this environment cannot be queried. Target configuration stays.
目标会登记到这里，保存后不能换环境。: The target is registered here and cannot be moved later.
保存后不能更换环境。: The environment cannot be changed after saving.
只会查询这里列出的范围。留空时按该项自己的默认处理。: Only the listed scope is queried. An empty value uses that field's own default.
编辑时留空表示不改；要更换就填新值。: On edit, leave it blank to keep the current value. Enter a new value to replace it.
小写字母、数字与连字符，创建后不可修改；排查时传这个名字。: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It cannot be changed later. Pass this name when investigating.
停用后不能使用该目标，配置会保留。: After you disable it, this target cannot be used. The configuration stays.
排查时不能查询其中的目标。配置仍保留，可以随时重新启用。: Targets in it cannot be queried. The configuration stays and you can enable it again.
删除后，这个目标的连接和密钥都会去掉，排查时不能再使用，也无法恢复。: Deleting removes the connection and secrets. It can no longer be used for investigation and cannot be restored.
删除后立即失效，不能恢复。: It stops working immediately and cannot be restored.
MCP 会暂时不能访问，直到重新生成。: MCP stays unavailable until you create a new one.
需要和私钥一起填写。: Enter it together with the private key.
不支持带口令的私钥。: Password-protected private keys are not supported.
只会执行单条查询，连接是只读的。: Only one query runs, and the connection is read-only.
只会查询，不会执行脚本。: It only runs queries and does not execute scripts.
只会读取代码，不会写入。: It only reads code and does not write.
只查看队列，不取消息。: It only inspects queues and does not take messages.
只查看堆积和有限消息，不加入消费组。: It only checks lag and a limited set of messages, and does not join a consumer group.
搜索必须带时间范围。: Searches must include a time range.
搜索必须带时间范围；探活会对每个授权主题做一次轻量 SearchLog。: Searches must include a time range; probe runs a light SearchLog on each authorized topic.
参数在记录时已截短。: The parameters were shortened when this was recorded.
请选中文字后复制: Select the text, then copy it.
近 24 小时还没有操作。: Nothing happened in the last 24 hours.
换个时间或动作，或清除筛选后再看。: Try another time or action, or clear the filters.
使用分配给你的账号登录。: Sign in with the account you were given.
看配置是否需要处理，以及刚刚发生的操作。: See what needs attention, and what just happened.

近 24 小时还没有工具调用。: No tool calls in the last 24 hours.
这个页面只有管理员可以打开。: Only an administrator can open this page.
这里只显示你自己的操作。: Only your own activity is shown here.
请先修改密码。改完后需要重新登录。: Change your password first. You will sign in again afterward.
管理员创建分析员，并设置初始密码。: Administrators create analyst accounts and set the first password.
管理可以登录的成员。: Manage the people who can sign in.
成员以分析员身份登录，首次登录必须修改密码。: The member signs in as an analyst and must change the password on first login.
小写字母、数字和连字符，创建后不能改。: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
留空则自动生成。填写时至少 8 位。: Leave blank to generate one. A typed password needs at least 8 characters.
登录名只能使用小写字母、数字和连字符: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
初始密码只显示这一次。离开或刷新后不能再查看。: This password is shown once. It cannot be viewed again after you leave or refresh.
请把密码交给对方，并提醒对方登录后马上修改。: Give this password to the person, and ask them to change it after signing in.
密码已经显示过，不能再次查看。: This password was already shown and cannot be viewed again.
只读：可查看环境与目标的连接信息；新增、修改、删除、启停、测试需要管理员。: Read-only: you can view environments and target connection details. Creating, editing, deleting, enabling/disabling, and testing require an administrator.
排查工具会拒绝使用其中的目标；需要管理员重新启用。: Troubleshooting tools will refuse targets in this environment until an administrator re-enables it.
请联系管理员创建环境并登记目标。: Ask an administrator to create an environment and register targets.
请联系管理员登记目标。: Ask an administrator to register targets.
同一来源 IP 在锁定时长内允许的登录失败次数；达到后暂时拒绝登录。按来源 IP: Failed logins allowed from one source IP within the lockout window; further attempts are rejected temporarily. Counted per source IP in memory and reset on restart.
达到失败次数后拒绝该来源登录的时长；到期自动解除。: How long logins from that source are rejected after the failure limit is reached.
每个账号最多保留的 MCP Token 数量；达到上限后需先删除旧 Token。: Maximum MCP tokens kept per account; delete an old token before creating a new one.
Token 从创建起算的有效天数；0 表示不过期，过期后 MCP 调用返回未认证: Token lifetime in days from creation; 0 means no expiry. Expired tokens get unauthenticated.
Web 登录会话有效期、登录失败保护与 MCP Token 限制。Session: Web session lifetime, login failure protection and MCP token limits. Shortening the session invalidates older sessions on the next request; page responses renew the cookie with the current lifetime.
Web 登录会话的最长有效期，最短 30 分钟。缩短后，已超过新时长的会话在下一: Maximum Web session lifetime, at least 30 minutes. Shortening it invalidates older sessions on the next request; page responses renew the cookie, JSON calls do not.
仅 SQLite 且存在 pending migration 时生效；新迁移前保: Only for SQLite when a pending migration exists; keeps the latest N backups before the migration (1-100).
整个进程同时进行的工具调用上限；0 表示不限制。达到上限的调用排队等待。: Maximum concurrent tool calls in the whole process; 0 means unlimited. Calls beyond the limit queue and wait.
每批删除的审计条数；越大清理越快，但单次锁表时间更长。: Audit rows deleted per batch; larger values clean faster but lock the table longer.
单轮清理最多运行的时间；达到时限后剩余记录留到下一轮。: Maximum time for one cleanup round; remaining rows wait for the next round.
池中连接超过该时长未使用则关闭；0 表示不回收。修改后在下一次取客户端时按新值清: Close pooled connections unused for this long; 0 disables idle reclamation. Changes apply on the next client fetch.
并发上限（每 target 与全局）在下一次取槽生效；已经在跑的调用不会被取消。: Concurrency limits (per target and global) apply on the next slot; running calls are not cancelled. Audit retention, cleanup interval, batch size and time limit apply on the next cleanup cycle.
连接器缓存上限与空闲回收在下一次取客户端时生效。SQLite 备份份数只在下次启: Connector cache limit and idle reclamation apply on the next client fetch. SQLite backup retention applies before the next startup migration.
每轮清理后按该间隔休眠；分片检查配置，改小最多 60 秒内生效，改大从当前轮开始: Sleeps for this interval after each cleanup; the setting is re-read in slices, so a smaller value applies within 60 seconds and a larger one from the current round.
页面已过期，请刷新后重试: This page has expired. Refresh and try again.
客户端安装完成，请重新测试连接: Client installed. Test the connection again.
